item.title: Pull request #3099 created
item.description:
3098 Clarify rules for data types in element-to-map()

In particular, clarify how sections §14.6.3 and §14.6.9 relate to each other. This clarification means that some test cases need to change: as far as I can see these test cases did not reflect the Jan 2026 version of the spec.

Fix #3098
